name: Exam Papers
description: One exam's papers for the candidate who has access to it: per-paper state, score once ended, and the action that fits. Reads the exam from the ?e= query parameter, and offers a chooser when none is given.

elements.label: Chooser Heading
elements.hint: Shown when the page is opened without naming an exam and the candidate has more than one

elements.label: No-access Message
elements.placeholder: e.g. You do not have access to this exam.

elements.label: Show Scores
elements.hint: Scores appear only for papers that have ended, whatever this is set to
